meta.name: voice-of-customer
meta.description: Builds the loop from what customers say to what gets changed — collecting feedback, distinguishing signal from noise, routing it to owners, and closing the loop back to the customer. Use this to set up a feedback program, design or interpret CSAT/NPS, decide what customer feedback deserves action, get product to act on recurring issues, or diagnose why feedback is collected but nothing changes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把客户反馈转化为产品改进行动
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果希望系统收集客户反馈并推动产品落地改进
copy.tagline_en: Turn customer feedback into product actions that matter
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want a systematic way to hear customers and turn their feedback into product changes

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会帮你把客户反馈整理成行动线索：按固定分类统计各类问题数量、给每个主题指定负责人，并设计“告诉客户你改了什么”的回应。它还会把 CSAT/NPS 分数当作看自由文字的入口，而不是孤立的目标。
howto.when: 当你想搭建客户反馈机制、解读 CSAT/NPS 数据，或想让反馈真正变成产品改动（包括诊断“收集了却没人改”）时，它会介入。

say.text: 帮我搭一个客户反馈闭环，收集之后要有动作。
say.note: 它会给出来源分类、负责人和复盘机制。

say.text: 这是上季度的 CSAT 数据，帮我解读一下。
say.note: 它提示先分段看文字原因，别只看平均分。

say.text: 很多客户要一个夜间导出功能，该不该做？
say.note: 它会先把问题量化，再判断是不是共性问题。

howto.what_en: Claude organizes raw customer feedback into a loop: categorize and count issues, name an owner for each theme, and craft replies that close the loop with the customer. It also treats CSAT/NPS as a prompt for free text, not a target.
howto.when_en: Use it when you want to set up feedback mechanisms, read CSAT/NPS, or turn feedback into product change—including diagnosing why collected feedback changes nothing.

say_en.text: Please design a feedback loop that ends in action.
say_en.note: Expect sources, taxonomy, owners, and review steps.

say_en.text: Here is last quarter's CSAT data. What should I make of it?
say_en.note: Reads it by segment and via open-text reasons.

say_en.text: Many customers want a night-export feature. Should we build it?
say_en.note: Quantifies the issue before calling it a shared problem.
